com.vector.cfg.workflow.groovy.update

Interface IUpdateWorkflowApi

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    IWorkflowApiEntryPoint.IWorkflowApi

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IUpdateWorkflowApi
    The Interface IUpdateWorkflowApi. *

    IWorkflowApi

    The IWorkflowApiEntryPoint.IWorkflowApi is the automation interface for workflows. It is available everywhere in any script using a property approach or using a delegate approach: 

    

 scriptTask("PropertyApproach", APPLICATION) {
     code {
         workflow.updateProject("MyProject.dpa", {
             ...
         })
     }
 }

 scriptTask("DelegateApproach", APPLICATION) {
     code {
         workflow {
             updateProject("MyProject.dpa",  {
                 ...
             })
         }
     }
 }

 scriptTask("DelegateApproach", APPLICATION) {
     code {

        dpaProjectFile ->

        projects.openProject(dpaProjectFile) {

           workflow {

               boolean isPreprocessingRequired = isFilePreprocessingRequired(project)
               boolean isUpdateRequired = isUpdateRequired(project)

               if(isPreprocessingRequired) {
                   filePreprocessingProject(project) {
                       ...
                   }
               }

               if(isUpdateRequired) {
                   updateProject(project) {
                       ...

                   }
               }
           }
        }
    }
 }

      • filePreprocessingProject

        @PublishedMethod
IFilePreprocessingResult filePreprocessingProject(java.lang.Object dpaFilePath,
                                                                    @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IFilePreprocessingProjectApi.class)
                                                                    groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        The filePreprocessingProject method starts only the file preprocessing part of the update workflow after the code closure was executed.

        File Preprocessing

        Using filePreprocessingProject(Object, Closure) an existing project can be preprocessed with new input data. The given code Closure, parameterizing the file preprocessing of the project, is delegated to the IFilePreprocessingProjectApi.

        The return type is com.vector.cfg.workflow.groovy.update.result.IFilePreprocessingResult that references the file preprocessing result.

        Parameters:
        dpaFilePath - the dpa file path
        code - the code
        Returns:
        the file preprocessing result

      • updateProject

        @PublishedMethod
<T> T updateProject(IProject project,
                                      @VDelegatesToWithClosureParam(value=IUpdateProjectApi.class)
                                      groovy.lang.Closure<T> code)
        This updateProject method starts the update workflow with a already loaded project after the code closure was executed.

        Update already loaded Project

        Using #updateProject(com.vector.cfg.util.IProjectContext, Closure) an existing and already loaded project can be updated with new input data. The given code Closure, parameterizing the update of the project, is delegated to the IUpdateProjectApi .

        Parameters:
        project - the IProject which was already loaded before.
        code - the update project API code.
